item.title: bussilab.rna2d v0.0.52
item.description: • Added exact state mixtures with state_positions and state_biases, allowing coupled paired/unpaired-state energy biases. Multiple disjoint state sets and reduce_state_space are supported; ensemble results combine all state components. • Added Molecule hard constraints (force_paired, force_unpaired). • Added centroid(), mea(), positional_entropy(), and ensemble_defect() for the complete ensemble, including state mixtures. • evaluate() and ensemble_defect() accept zero-based NumPy pair tables; evaluate() also accepts a two-dimensional batch of tables. • Added sparse exact-pair base_pair_biases and d_free_energy_d_base_pair_biases(); continuous biases retain their sub-0.01 kcal/mol precision with unpatched ViennaRNA. Impossible pairs may remain in the bias list and have zero ensemble probability. • Added evaluate() for one structure or a one-dimensional iterable of structures or (structure, value) pairs, including output from sample() and suboptimal_structures(). Structures can be rescored by another Molecule with the same sequence. Noncanonical or too-short pairs, and structures violating hard constraints, return infinite energy. • Added sample_to_numpy() and suboptimal_to_numpy() for zero-based pair tables and normalized log weights, plus mean_bp_distance() and free-energy derivatives with respect to one-body and state biases. • Exposed the resolved temperature and Boltzmann constant as read-only Molecule.temperature and Molecule.boltzmann_constant properties, along with sequence, no_lonely_pair, pf_smooth, NaCl, and parameters. Renamed the constructor's seq argument to sequence; seq remains a deprecated keyword alias. • Added Molecule.to_kwargs() to inspect and reuse resolved constructor settings. • Removed the samples and suboptimal_delta options from pairing_correlation_matrix(); it now always returns the exact partition-function result. • Changed sample() to return unweighted structure strings by default; sample(weights=True) retains structures with importance log weights. • Added set_random_seed() for reproducible sampling without changing NumPy's global random state. • Added no_lonely_pair and pf_smooth options and set_default_parameters() / reset_default_parameters() for new molecules. Partition-function smoothing now defaults to off so ensemble and structure energies use the same model. • Fixed suboptimal enumeration with positive one-body penalties on unpatched ViennaRNA and parameter-set loading with ViennaRNA 2.7.2. • Fixed validation of temperature and salt settings: zero or non-finite temperatures and non-finite salt concentrations are now rejected.
item.content:encoded:
• Added exact state mixtures with state_positions and state_biases, allowing coupled paired/unpaired-state energy biases. Multiple disjoint state sets and reduce_state_space are supported; ensemble results combine all state components.
  • Added Molecule hard constraints (force_paired, force_unpaired).
  • Added centroid(), mea(), positional_entropy(), and ensemble_defect() for the complete ensemble, including state mixtures.
  • evaluate() and ensemble_defect() accept zero-based NumPy pair tables; evaluate() also accepts a two-dimensional batch of tables.
  • Added sparse exact-pair base_pair_biases and d_free_energy_d_base_pair_biases(); continuous biases retain their sub-0.01 kcal/mol precision with unpatched ViennaRNA. Impossible pairs may remain in the bias list and have zero ensemble probability.
  • Added evaluate() for one structure or a one-dimensional iterable of structures or (structure, value) pairs, including output from sample() and suboptimal_structures(). Structures can be rescored by another Molecule with the same sequence. Noncanonical or too-short pairs, and structures violating hard constraints, return infinite energy.
  • Added sample_to_numpy() and suboptimal_to_numpy() for zero-based pair tables and normalized log weights, plus mean_bp_distance() and free-energy derivatives with respect to one-body and state biases.
  • Exposed the resolved temperature and Boltzmann constant as read-only Molecule.temperature and Molecule.boltzmann_constant properties, along with sequence, no_lonely_pair, pf_smooth, NaCl, and parameters. Renamed the constructor's seq argument to sequence; seq remains a deprecated keyword alias.
  • Added Molecule.to_kwargs() to inspect and reuse resolved constructor settings.
  • Removed the samples and suboptimal_delta options from pairing_correlation_matrix(); it now always returns the exact partition-function result.
  • Changed sample() to return unweighted structure strings by default; sample(weights=True) retains structures with importance log weights.
  • Added set_random_seed() for reproducible sampling without changing NumPy's global random state.
  • Added no_lonely_pair and pf_smooth options and set_default_parameters() / reset_default_parameters() for new molecules. Partition-function smoothing now defaults to off so ensemble and structure energies use the same model.
  • Fixed suboptimal enumeration with positive one-body penalties on unpatched ViennaRNA and parameter-set loading with ViennaRNA 2.7.2.
  • Fixed validation of temperature and salt settings: zero or non-finite temperatures and non-finite salt concentrations are now rejected.

item.title: bussilab.rna2d v0.0.51
item.description: • Introduced Molecule with continuous per-nucleotide pairing penalties, MFE prediction, partition functions, base-pair probabilities, suboptimal enumeration, sampling, and suboptimal coverage. • Added pairing_correlation_matrix() for joint paired-state probabilities from partition functions, samples, or suboptimal structures.
item.content:encoded:
• Introduced Molecule with continuous per-nucleotide pairing penalties, MFE prediction, partition functions, base-pair probabilities, suboptimal enumeration, sampling, and suboptimal coverage.
  • Added pairing_correlation_matrix() for joint paired-state probabilities from partition functions, samples, or suboptimal structures.
